Entries whose bootstrap intervals overlap the previous one are marked tied. The order and the floor are a presentation convention, not a verdict: §8 defines the headline numbers

rank_floor.note: post-hoc presentation convention adopted 2026-10-15 after seeing the wave-2 data (B5b-2 ruling 2; protocol §8 note), not a pre-registered criterion: it orders the catalogue and changes no verdict

gaussian_x3@2.censoring: protocol §7: an attempt that hit the timeout, crashed or wrote a non-finite answer is a failed attempt; in a closed leg a missing run is a failed attempt censored at the timeout; an operational kill (Terminated below the timeout) is not an attempt (rerun it)
limitations: Pilot-derived timeouts are 10 x laptop medians and RAL ran 4-7 x faster than the laptop (B5a dry run): censoring is lenient on RAL for those cells
